name: seis-big-tech-open-source-foundation
intent: Evaluate official, verified, and actively maintained open-source technology from major firms before SEIS implementation work.
operating_mode: registry-first, no dependency or cloud activation without task scope
evaluation_policy: Prefer official vendor pages, verified GitHub organizations, or foundation governance pages.
Mark tools as candidate only when they fit SEIS architecture, accessibility, performance, or maintainability goals.
Keep cloud deployment, database mutation, account reads, and AI model calls approval-gated.
Favor portable open standards and avoid vendor lock-in unless the feature explicitly benefits from the platform.

firms.default_decision: Use for web quality, official docs, Firebase/Cloud planning, and Google AI review only when scoped.
Use TypeScript and Playwright as primary candidates for code clarity and UI validation; keep Azure provisioning gated.
Use React ecosystem knowledge where the current app already depends on React; keep PyTorch/AI use registry-only unless needed.
Use for infrastructure patterns and IaC review; block deploy/provision until explicit approval.
Use for Apple-platform or WebKit compatibility work; keep out of core web stack unless task-specific.
Use for edge runtime planning and local worker validation; block production deployment.
Use Next.js/Turborepo alignment because this repo already has a Next foundation; keep deployment approval-gated.
Use official docs and SDKs for explicit AI feature scopes; keep model calls and secrets approval-gated.
